release_notes: Dealer screen: search for an existing dealer first, then add a new one if there is no match. The form is re-ordered - dealer code, zone, company, dealer name, trade name, market, phone, alt phone, NID, trade licence, email, and a new Gelender field. Sector is gone from the dealer screen, and markets are listed directly. Payment mode and Lead status are replaced by searchable Customer type and Business type dropdowns.
